EXPLANATION

Our task is to find A, B and C such that

13x2−19x−16(3x+2)(x−3)(x+1)=A(3x+2)+B(x−3)+C(x+1).

Multiplying both sides by (3x+2)(x−3)(x+1) gives

13x2−19x−16=A(x−3)(x+1)+B(3x+2)(x+1)+C(3x+2)(x−3).

For x=−23, we get 13(−23)2−19(−23)−16=A(−23−3)(−23+1)=+B(3(−23)+2)(−23+1)=+C(3(−23)+1)(−23−3)529+383−16=A((−11)(1)9)52+114−1449=A(−119)A=−2211A=−2. For x=3, we obtain 13(3)2−19(3)−16=A(3−3)(3+1)=+B(3(3)+2)(3+1)=+C(3(3)+2)(3−3)117−57−16=B(44)B=4444B=1. For x=−1, we get 13(−1)2−19(−1)−16=A(−1−3)(−1+1)=+B(3(−1)+2)(−1+1)=+C(3(−1)+2)(−1−3)13+19−16=C(4)C=164C=4.

Hence, A+B+C=(−2)+1+4=3.
